# Font Awesome Free 6.4.0 audit metadata

These files were extracted verbatim from the official `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.4.0` npm archive already downloaded for the earlier audits:

https://registry.npmjs.org/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/-/fontawesome-free-6.4.0.tgz

The vendored files are `metadata/icon-families.json`, `metadata/categories.yml`, `package.json`, and `LICENSE.txt`. The adjacent license is the upstream license.

The package's `css/all.min.css` was previously verified byte-for-byte against the exact CDN stylesheet used by `baseline/index.html`; see `evidence/02-audit-classes.md`.
